question.text: Detecting Contradiction: Ye Lu said her budget 'cannot be too expensive,' but Shi Yan suggested a 'professional outdoor photography bag.' Could this be contradictory?

questions.original_answer: Yes, there may be a contradiction, as professional outdoor photography bags could exceed the budget of 2000-3000 yuan. However, in the conversation, Shi Yan also suggested a more flexible alternative of a "carrying system plus specialized photography accessories." Moreover, Ye Lu later accepted the modular approach, so the contradiction was resolved within the dialogue.
questions.validation_notes: Contradiction Detection: Identify potentially conflicting information (budget constraints vs. professional package recommendations) and assess whether contradictions are recognized and resolved in the dialogue.
